motion: Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. In this photo of the Midtown skyline at dusk, scattered office windows across the towers blink on and off at random, a few at a time. On the river at right the small boats drift slowly across the water, and a tiny aircraft light blinks as it crosses the upper sky. Every building keeps its exact shape and edges; the crescent moon stays put. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. Over eight seconds the sky deepens from the red horizon band into dark blue night, the orange glow sinking below the skyline. As the light drops, more and more windows glow warm and the lit tower crown at center brightens against the darkening sky. Building outlines stay rigid and unchanged, the moon fixed in place top right. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. Between the fluted marble columns the green trees and shrubs on the hillside sway softly in a warm breeze, leaves shimmering in the sunlight. Dappled light flickers faintly on the bright floor at the far end of the colonnade. The columns, ceiling beams and polished floor stay solid and perfectly still, keeping their exact shape. Calm, quiet afternoon. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. Time passes quickly: the bands of sunlight and shadow between the columns slide slowly across the polished stone floor from right to left, stretching as they go, and the reflections on the floor slide with them. The light on the column faces shifts from warm to cool. The colonnade itself stays rigid and unchanged, every column in its exact place. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. The silver subway train on the right keeps rushing past along the platform edge as one continuous motion blur, its windows streaking by, light flashing off its side. The people at the far left shift and walk slowly along the platform. The riveted pillar, its sign and the yellow edge line stay sharp, exact and still, lettering unchanged. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. The blurred train on the right gradually slows to a crawl, its streaking side settling into a steady silver car. An overhead fluorescent tube flickers twice and steadies. The people at the far left drift slowly out of view to the left. The pillar with its sign, the ceiling ducts and the platform tiles stay perfectly still and unchanged. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. On the dark blue brick facade, the glowing amber window flickers and pulses gently, like a television playing in an empty room, its warm light breathing brighter and dimmer. The lower lit window stays steady. The bricks, window frames and glass keep their exact shape and stay still. Quiet late-night mood. The camera does not move at all.

idea: lights go out one by one
motion: Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. Late at night on this blue brick facade, the bright amber window clicks off, leaving the pane dark blue like its neighbours. A beat later the lower warm window fades to dark too, and the whole wall settles into deep blue night. The building, bricks and window frames stay rigid and unchanged throughout. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. On the dark screen behind the glasses, the candlestick chart scrolls slowly to the left, new red candles stepping lower at the right edge. The same moving chart is mirrored in both lenses, in step with the screen. The glasses and laptop stay perfectly still and keep their exact shape. Low, moody screen light. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. The chart on the screen holds still while the screen's glow slowly breathes, brightening and dimming, and the green and red reflections in the lenses shimmer faintly with it. Toward the end the screen light fades down, leaving the glasses' metal rims catching the last glint. Glasses and laptop stay motionless and exact. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. A soft band of warm light glides slowly across the rows of gold bars from upper left to lower right, bright glints travelling over the stamped lion crests and polished edges as it passes. The bars stay solid, rigid and in place, their stamped markings crisp and unchanged. Rich, warm gleam. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. The warm light on the gold bars slowly fades, shadow creeping across the rows from the edges inward, until the bright gold turns dull, dim brass-brown and the shine is nearly gone. The bars never move; their shapes and stamped markings stay exact. Slow, sinking mood. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. The crown pendant swings gently on the gold rope chain like a slow pendulum, a few degrees each way, then settles. As it turns, the small diamonds catch the light in quick sparkles and the deep red stone glows. The chain flexes slightly with the swing. Pure black background stays black. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. The necklace hangs perfectly still while a single bright highlight travels slowly along the twisted gold rope chain, from the left end down to the crown and back up the right side. When it reaches the crown, the diamonds flash and the red stone warms from within. Black background stays plain and dark. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. A cold winter breeze moves through the street: the flag at right ripples and flaps, the bare tree branches sway slightly, and the small string lights wrapped round the trunk twinkle softly. The red brick front, stoop, steel gate, door and parked grey car stay rigid and exactly as shown. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. Light snow begins falling over the brownstone stoop, fine flakes drifting down past the bare tree and the steel gate, a few settling on the roof and trunk of the parked grey car. The flag stirs gently. The brick front, stairs, door and car stay exactly as they are. Quiet winter afternoon. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. Under the graffiti-covered steel span, the subway train on the right with its red tail lights pulls slowly away into the distance, the red lights shrinking and fading down the track. The graffiti, girders, mesh fence and pink railings stay rigid and unchanged. Night sky stays deep blue. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. Far down the long walkway, the single small figure already there keeps walking away, slowly shrinking into the distant lights. A lamp under the span flickers, and the train's red tail lights pulse dimly. The graffiti steelwork, pink railings and pavement stay still and exact. Empty late-night calm. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. The person in the varsity jacket and wide pale jeans keeps walking toward the left of frame with a relaxed stride, the silver boombox swinging slightly from their hand, until they step out of frame left, leaving the graffiti-covered rusty door alone. Only their torso and legs ever show, as in the photo. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. The person stops mid-stride and steps in place to a laid-back beat, weight rocking side to side, wide jeans swaying, the silver boombox bobbing in rhythm from its handle. The framing stays the same, showing only torso and legs. The graffiti door behind stays still and unchanged. Easy, head-nodding groove. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. The record on the turntable spins, and the DJ's hand in the foreground pulls it back and pushes it forward in quick rhythmic scratches, the label blurring and snapping. The other hand nudges a fader on the glowing mixer. The blurred background stays soft and out of focus. Warm orange club light. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. The deck keeps spinning steadily under the resting hand while the soft, out-of-focus crowd in the background sways and bobs to the music, staying blurred. Orange and purple club lights pulse in time behind the decks, and the laptop glow flickers. The turntable and mixer stay sharp and solid. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. The neon signs over the shop door come alive: the blue LED border around the green ATM sign chases in a loop, the smoke shop sign flickers, and the round lottery sign glows and pulses softly. Every sign keeps its exact lettering. The shelves, door and pavement stay still. Late-night corner store hum. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. Light from passing cars on the unseen street sweeps across the scene: bright headlight reflections slide over the metal shutters and the glass door, and a soft glow runs along the pavement, then fades. The neon signs hold steady. The shopfront, shelves and signs stay exactly as they are. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. Snow flurries drift down over the empty basketball court seen through the dark chain-link fence, flakes swirling past the hoop and settling on the snowbanks. The fence in the foreground stays perfectly still and soft. The buildings, trees and court lines stay rigid and unchanged. Cold, quiet winter day. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. The pale steam plume above the far rooftop drifts and curls in the wind, the bare trees behind the court sway gently, and loose powder lifts off the snowbanks in small gusts. The daylight dims slightly toward dusk and the streetlight beside the hoop flickers on. Fence, hoop and buildings stay rigid and exact. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. The yellow taxi pulls away slowly to the right and drives out of frame, revealing the metal barrier and white wall behind it. The fire escapes, brick wall and the striped barriers in the foreground stay rigid and unchanged. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. The yellow taxi sits idling in place, its body trembling very slightly. The two amber warning lamps on the striped barriers in front blink alternately, and the thin wire strung across the fire escapes sways a little. The rooftop ad and the taxi's markings stay exactly as shown. The building and stairs stay perfectly still. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. Time passes quickly: the sharp shadows cast by the rusted fire escape grating and ladder slide slowly across the brick wall and stone ornaments, stretching and shifting angle as the sun moves. The iron balcony and ladder themselves stay solid, rigid and in place. Warm low sunlight. The camera does not move at all.

Static locked-off camera, fixed shot. A cloud drifts over the sun: the bright light on the rusted fire escape and brick dims, the hard shadows of the grating soften and fade, then the sun returns and the crisp shadows snap back. The ironwork, ladder and carved stone stay perfectly still and exact. The camera does not move at all.
